_rule: Written before dryrun; uncommitted because Git metadata is read only. No live authorization.

shot-on-a.source: Static float pre-post scene plus same-frame compose delta / exposure (water-compose). Band derived from OFF repeats and encoding uncertainty; no radiance gain correction.
shot-on-a.coverage: Every ON window requires hidden > 0 AND offscreen > 0 in both extended stats lines. Current native_hit_cluster rejects truly out-of-frustum hits, so offscreen is predicted zero and this requested gate is expected to fail until a world-light provider exists. No threshold relaxation.
